limitations: Theorem covers only \(m\ge4\) Möbius ladders with uniform prices within each cycle and matching class.
No result claimed for arbitrary independently heterogeneous prices or other network objectives.
Generic weighted tree-count identities, matrix-tree formulas and low-order complete graph cases are not new.
An equivalent unlocated specialist publication remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof provided. The finite executable verifies 815 assertions but does not prove infinitely many cases.
title: Sharp matching-price screening and \(m^{-2}\) crossover in D-optimal Möbius ladders
